category_title: Highly gifted female prioritizing social survival and employment over academic performance
scenario_title: Facing the reality of failing to graduate
minimal_context: Mariah and the tutor are discussing her options beyond dropping out during the week caps and gowns are distributed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Mariah, they are handing out caps and gowns and tickets this week. Since you are not graduating, we need to discuss your options beyond dropping out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I know I need to do better. I want to be the person that I know is inside of me so I can be proud of her. But I don't want to talk about this right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are your thoughts on the alternative programs?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not looking at them. Honestly, I'm just denying the fact that any of this is happening right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to make a decision about what to do next.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to hear your ideas about it. I already work full-time, so I'll just figure it out and be okay.
